historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes duration and cooling risk but narrows cross-subsystem BurnIn coverage to storage and offers potentially destructive unspecified tools.

original_test_intent: Stress the approved CPU, memory and HDD/RAID scope continuously for 48 hours with the configured BurnInTest profile, proving full intended loading, clean logs and absence of hangs or blue screens.
original_method: After critical approval, launch the pinned licensed profile with an isolated storage boundary, tracked process/watchdog and continuous CPU, memory, storage, controller, thermal, power, OS and BMC monitoring, then stop cleanly and restore only approved test artifacts.
manual_activity: User supplies licensed profile, exact subsystem/storage scope and thresholds; operator owns KVM/OOB and abort/recovery; agent runs and monitors only the approved 48-hour workload.
required_inputs: BurnInTest license, version, checksum and exact CPU/memory/HDD config
Stable RAID VD/drive/mount and isolated test-file/data boundary
Expected CPU/memory load and storage workload parameters
Thermal, power, ECC, storage, responsiveness, watchdog and log abort limits
48-hour window, cooling, backup, KVM/OOB, cleanup and recovery
safety_requirements: Exclude boot, production, management and unknown storage unless explicitly approved
Preserve baseline OS/BMC logs before any authorized clear/reset step
Verify cooling/power headroom and continuous out-of-band monitoring
Stop on hang, blue screen/reboot, OOM/ECC, data/filesystem/RAID/controller/media/thermal/power error or monitoring loss
Do not substitute badblocks, format, auto-repair, rebuild, reboot or delete non-test data
agent_execution_scope: Validate pinned BurnIn profile and exact targets
Launch tracked workload with watchdog/abort and time-series evidence
Monitor CPU/memory/storage utilization, errors, health, temperature/power and OS/BMC state for 48 hours
Stop cleanly and remove only manifested test artifacts; do not choose targets or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve licensed config, target/data/full-load model, limits and recovery
Maintain operator/OOB ownership throughout the long run
Review full 48-hour evidence and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic fio/badblocks covers only storage, may be destructive and cannot substitute for the configured CPU/memory/HDD BurnInTest or blue-screen/full-load criteria.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the pinned licensed BurnInTest configuration for 48 hours against exact approved subsystems and isolated storage, with tracked execution and continuous multi-domain telemetry.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: CPU, memory and HDD selection, over-48-hour duration, full-load check, no hang/blue screen and source 30/2880 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Operate the 48-hour soak as a supervised long-run with a frozen profile, isolated storage artifacts, watchdog and complete time-series evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target safety and durable monitoring while retaining combined load and duration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No generic storage-only tool may replace CPU/memory/HDD BurnIn coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Task Manager snapshots can show transient utilization but not 48-hour coverage; continuous metrics and tool results are needed.

project_override_considerations: If BurnInTest is unavailable, an alternative workload requires explicit equivalence approval for CPU, memory, storage, duration, load and error reporting; no automatic substitution is allowed.
expected_evidence: Exact subsystem and stable storage/data map
Complete 48-hour BurnIn results, parameters, PID/watchdog and exit status
Continuous CPU/memory/storage load plus ECC/OOM/controller/drive/thermal/power telemetry
Preserved baseline and complete BMC SEL plus OS event/journal/dmesg/syslog
Hang/blue-screen/reboot record, cleanup/restoration, recovery notes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently defines a combined BurnInTest soak; DeepSeek's storage-only suggestion is incomplete coverage rather than source ambiguity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Licensed tool, target and long-run controls are supplyable prerequisites; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Restores combined CPU/memory/HDD 48-hour coverage and adds safe target, continuous telemetry, watchdog and recovery boundaries.
independent_technical_reasoning: A system may survive storage I/O while failing only under simultaneous CPU and memory thermal/power pressure, so a storage-only substitute cannot establish the intended soak. Long-run acceptance also depends on continuous evidence and OOB detection of hangs or blue screens; endpoint logs and a Task Manager screenshot are insufficient.
